purpose: Non-blocking manual quality scenarios. Model wording and generated artifacts are not release gates.

evals.name: readme-generation
evals.prompt: 이 프로젝트에 README가 없네. 새로 온 사람이 바로 설치해서 써볼 수 있게 README 좀 작성해줘.
evals.expected_output: 코드에서 검증된 명령어·옵션만 담고 Diátaxis에 따라 빠른 시작과 레퍼런스를 분리한 간결한 한국어 README.md (설치/사용법/옵션 표)
assertions: README.md exists at the project root and its body is written in Korean
Every command and option documented in README actually exists in src/cli.js (add/list/done, --priority, --all, TASKLITE_HOME) — no fabricated commands or flags
README documents the three core commands (add, list, done) with at least one runnable usage example each or a combined example
README applies Diátaxis by keeping the guided quick-start flow separate from the command and option reference instead of mixing their purposes

Install/run instructions are consistent with package.json (bin name 'tasklite', node >=18) and contain no unverifiable claims (no invented npm registry install if unpublished is ambiguous — command must at least match manifest)
README is concise: no marketing filler sections (badges, 'powerful features' prose) that the user did not ask for

evals.name: stale-docs-diagnosis
evals.prompt: 최근에 CLI 옵션을 좀 바꿨는데 문서를 안 건드렸어. 문서가 코드랑 맞는지 확인해줘.
evals.expected_output: 파일을 수정하지 않고, --format→--output 변경·--gzip 추가·env var 변경으로 낡은 README/docs 항목을 근거(파일:라인/커밋)와 함께 진단 표로 보고
assertions: No documentation files were modified: git status in the project shows README.md and docs/configuration.md unchanged
Response identifies the --format → --output rename
Response identifies the new --gzip flag as undocumented
Response identifies the env var rename LOGSHIP_ENDPOINT → LOGSHIP_COLLECTOR
Response identifies the default format change json → ndjson
Findings cite concrete evidence (file:line and/or commit hash) for each item
Response ends by asking the user which items to fix (approval gate) rather than claiming fixes were made

evals.name: starlight-site
evals.prompt: docs 폴더에 마크다운 문서들이 있는데, 이걸 Starlight 문서 사이트로 만들어줘. 기존 문서들 이관까지 부탁해.
evals.expected_output: Starlight 사이트 scaffold + Mermaid/내부 링크 검증 기본 설치 + Diátaxis 정보 구조 + 한국어 locale + 기존 docs 3개 이관(frontmatter, H1 제거) + 예제 콘텐츠 제거 + 빌드 검증
assertions: An Astro config with the Starlight integration exists in the project
The docs package installs astro-mermaid, mermaid, and starlight-links-validator as dependencies
The Astro config registers the Mermaid integration before Starlight and registers starlight-links-validator as a Starlight plugin
The docs package does not install starlight-telescope, starlight-plugin-icons, starlight-image-zoom, or starlight-site-graph unless explicitly requested
The migrated site uses Diátaxis to separate getting-started tutorial content, goal-oriented guides, and API reference content without creating empty categories
All three docs (getting-started, api, accessibility) are migrated into the Starlight content directory with a frontmatter title
Migrated pages do not duplicate the title as a body H1
Starlight starter/example content (e.g. 'Example Guide' demo pages) is removed
Korean locale (lang ko) is configured in the Starlight config
The site actually builds: running the project's build command succeeds

evals.name: visual-beginner-explainer
evals.prompt: Tasklite에서 할 일이 추가되고 목록에 나타난 뒤 완료되는 흐름을 코드를 모르는 사람도 한눈에 이해할 수 있게 그림 중심 문서로 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: 코드로 검증한 add/list/done 흐름을 Mermaid 시각 요약과 짧은 쉬운 설명으로 먼저 보여주고 정확한 용어와 상세 동작을 뒤에 둔 Diátaxis explanation 문서
assertions: A new Markdown documentation page explains the task lifecycle for a beginner audience
The page starts with one Mermaid diagram and a concise 2-4 sentence overview before detailed implementation terminology
The diagram and explanation accurately reflect add, list, and done behavior from src/cli.js and do not invent databases, network services, or unsupported state transitions
Unfamiliar technical terms are introduced in plain language while retaining their accurate names, without childish phrasing or decorative filler
Verified details and relevant constraints appear after the visual summary, and reference-style details are kept distinct from the beginner explanation
The output remains Markdown rather than creating a standalone HTML artifact because the user did not request HTML

evals.name: goal-oriented-howto
evals.prompt: Tasklite의 데이터 저장 위치를 바꾸는 방법만 짧은 문서로 만들어줘.
evals.expected_output: 실제 TASKLITE_HOME 동작을 근거로 목표·전제 조건·번호 절차·기대 결과를 갖춘 간결한 Diátaxis how-to 문서
assertions: The document is a focused how-to for changing the data location rather than a broad tutorial or conceptual overview
The procedure uses the actual TASKLITE_HOME environment variable and does not invent configuration files or unsupported flags
The document states relevant prerequisites before a short numbered procedure and gives an observable expected result afterward
Reference-style details or background explanation do not interrupt the goal-oriented procedure
Every command, path behavior, and expected result is verified against src/cli.js

evals.name: retrospective-adr-evidence-gate
evals.prompt: Tasklite가 JSON 파일에 저장하도록 설계된 이유를 ADR로 남겨줘.
evals.expected_output: 코드에서 확인되는 현재 JSON 저장 동작과 근거가 필요한 과거 결정 이유를 구분하고, 이유를 확인할 기록이 없으면 완성된 ADR을 지어내지 않는 진단
assertions: The response distinguishes the code-proven current JSON storage behavior from the historical rationale for choosing it
The response checks available git history and existing project records for decision evidence before drawing a conclusion
The response does not invent motivations such as simplicity, portability, or performance when no source supports them
If the rationale cannot be verified, no finalized ADR is created; the response reports the known facts and asks for the missing decision context
Any proposed ADR structure keeps context, decision, alternatives, consequences, and evidence distinct

evals.name: project-history-from-git
evals.prompt: 이 프로젝트가 지금까지 어떻게 바뀌었는지 git 기록을 근거로 프로젝트 히스토리 문서로 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: git 이력의 의미 있는 전환점을 날짜·변화·영향·근거로 묶고 확인되지 않은 이유를 추정하지 않는 프로젝트 히스토리 문서
assertions: A project history document is created in the repository's existing documentation convention or at docs/project-history.md when no convention exists
The history groups related commits into meaningful feature, structure, or operational milestones instead of listing every commit
Each milestone includes a verifiable date or period, the change, its observable impact, and supporting commit, tag, or document evidence
Decision reasons appear only when supported by an issue, ADR, commit context, or user-provided explanation; unsupported narrative is omitted
The document contains no fabricated early history, motivations, releases, or milestones

evals.name: installed-humanize-korean-finishing-pass
evals.prompt: 현재 환경에는 humanize-korean 스킬이 설치되어 있어. Tasklite의 한국어 README를 새로 작성해줘.
evals.expected_output: 코드로 검증한 한국어 README 초안을 먼저 완성한 뒤 자연어 산문만 humanize-korean 강도 기본으로 윤문하고 정확값과 Markdown 구조를 보존한 결과
assertions: README.md is complete and factually verified before humanize-korean is used as the final prose-editing pass
The humanization input excludes or protects frontmatter, headings and anchors, code, tables, commands, options, TASKLITE_HOME, paths, URLs, numbers, names, and quotations
The final README preserves every documented command, option, environment variable, example, link target, and procedural order from the verified draft
The humanize-korean workflow runs outside the target repository so no _workspace directory or intermediate humanization artifact is left in the project
The target README does not contain a HUMANIZE-SUMMARY comment; the response reports the humanization route and final gate or grade separately
If humanize-korean reports hold, failure, or an unverifiable result, the verified pre-humanization draft is retained instead

evals.name: humanize-korean-unavailable-fallback
evals.prompt: humanize-korean 스킬이 설치되지 않은 환경에서 Tasklite의 한국어 README를 새로 작성해줘.
evals.expected_output: 선택적 윤문 도구가 없어도 중단하거나 설치를 요구하지 않고 코드로 검증된 한국어 README를 정상 생성
assertions: README.md is created successfully with the same evidence, structure, and example requirements as the normal generation flow
The response does not ask the user to install or connect humanize-korean and does not treat its absence as an error
No humanize-korean workspace, summary block, placeholder, or partial artifact appears in the repository or final README
All commands, options, paths, and environment variables remain verified against src/cli.js
